name: singlet_programs_coexpression_module_detection
title: Gene-gene co-expression module detection
description: Detects gene modules from gene-gene co-expression within one cell type and returns gene-to-module assignments, a module eigengene per analysed unit, and kME membership scores. The default method model_pairs fits depth-adjusted covariances with per-pair tests and clusters the significant pairs with Leiden; wgcna, hdwgcna and leiden_gene_graph are heuristic comparators. Writes varm, obsm, uns and models members. Do not use it to infer directed regulators or to pool several cell types; use the grn or programs tasks for those.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: model_pairs is the default; the other three are heuristic comparators.

subset.description: Cells to analyse, selected by an obs key. model_pairs needs exactly one cell type.

key.description: obs column that labels cell types or groups.

value.description: Level of the key to analyse; required for model_pairs.

input.description: Expression layer, gene filter and optional split key for preservation.

layer.description: Layer to read; model_pairs needs counts, other methods a log-normalised layer.

gene_select.description: Gene filter: variable genes, or genes passing the expressed-fraction threshold.

min_expressed_fraction.description: Minimum share of cells expressing a gene, applied before the gene filter.

split_key.description: obs key of donors or studies for preservation splits; null skips preservation.

model_pairs.description: Options for the default pair-covariance method.

irls_n_iter.description: Maximum IRLS iterations per moment regression (CS-CORE default).

fdr.description: Benjamini-Hochberg level for keeping gene pairs before clustering (proposed).

resolution.description: Leiden modularity resolution on the significant-pair graph.

network_type.description: Sign handling in the soft-threshold adjacency.

soft_power.description: Soft power, or auto for the smallest power reaching rsquared_cut.

rsquared_cut.description: Scale-free fit threshold used by automatic soft-power selection.

deep_split.description: Dynamic tree cut sensitivity; higher gives more, smaller modules.

min_module_size.description: Smallest module kept; capped at half the gene count, as in WGCNA.

merge_cut_height.description: Height below which similar modules are merged.

hdwgcna.description: Options for the hdWGCNA comparator (metacell-based, signed networks, heuristic).

soft_power.description: Soft power, or auto over the hdWGCNA power grid.

deep_split.description: Dynamic tree cut sensitivity; the hdWGCNA default is 4.

min_module_size.description: Smallest module kept, as in hdWGCNA.

merge_cut_height.description: Merge height below which modules are combined, as in hdWGCNA.

leiden_gene_graph.description: Options for the Leiden gene-graph comparator (heuristic).

k.description: Neighbours per gene in the kNN graph (proposed default).

similarity.description: Gene-gene similarity used for graph edges.

resolution.description: Leiden modularity resolution; the leidenalg default is 1.0.

seed.description: Random seed for Leiden clustering and metacell sampling.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. varm/coexpr_module. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed calls: method, n_genes_tested, n_modules, n_unassigned, n_significant_pairs (model_pairs), soft_power (wgcna, hdwgcna), median_module_size.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
